research_insight_text_link.research_insight_description: SentiLink Corp. is focused on enhancing identity verification technologies. Their research includes a system and method for detecting synthetic identities by determining a synthetic identity score for users. This score indicates the likelihood of a user employing a synthetic identity for various activities. The development aims to improve the detection and blocking of fraudulent identities, ensuring secure transactions and interactions.

overview_description.description:
SentiLink is a technology company that helps in detecting and blocking synthetic identities. Its technology links with fraudulent crime rings to detect and block synthetic identities by searching for statistical anomalies through real-time application programming interfaces and risk analyst tools. This enables business clients to identify fake people and other connected fraudulent applications to harm the bottom line of the organizations.

The company was founded in 2017 and is headquartered in San Francisco, California.

about_short_description.short_description: SentiLink is an identity verification technology company that helps in detecting and blocking synthetic identities.

product.name: Synthetic Fraud Score
product.description: A risk score that detects first- and third-party synthetic fraud by evaluating identity and behavioral signals at the application stage.

product.name: ID Theft Score
product.description: A risk score that identifies applicants associated with traditional identity theft and helps organizations reduce fraud losses.

product.name: Facets
product.description: A data and analytics product that provides identity, fraud, and network attributes for building risk models and rules-based decisioning.

product.name: eCBSV
product.description: A consent-based service that validates name, date of birth, and Social Security number combinations against records from the Social Security Administration in real time.

product.name: Intercept
product.description: An investigation platform that combines identity intelligence, fraud signals, and analyst workflows for reviewing high-stakes fraud and identity cases.

product.name: ID Complete
product.description: An identity-data completion service that appends missing or partial application information, including Social Security numbers and dates of birth.
